defs.def: a hollow metal object, often shaped like a cup, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes 铃（声）；钟（声）

ex.s: When the final bell rang in June, I walked away with a yearbook full of messages about writing’s most powerful significance — the ability to connect people, to put us in another’s skin, to teach us what it means to be human.
ex.t: 当六月的下课铃响起，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些话道出了写作最强大的意义——把人们连接起来、让我们设身处地、教会我们生而为人的含义。

ex.s: I really envy youD. that name rings a bell
ex.t: 我真羡慕你。D. 那个名字听起来很耳熟。

ex.t: 接着贝尔让电报有了声音。

ex.s: He gives his harness bells a shake Listen to the poem.
ex.t: 他摇了摇马具上的铃铛 听这首诗。

ex.s: Spain Spanish people eat one grape each time the bell rings at One grape stands for (3) of the coming year.
ex.t: 西班牙 西班牙人在每次钟声敲响时吃一颗葡萄 一颗葡萄代表着来年的(3)。

defs.def: an electrical device which makes a ringing sound when a button on it is pushed; the sound that it makes, used as a signal or a warning 电铃（声）

ex.s: For example, CT scanning was used to identify two silver coins and a bell.
ex.t: 例如，CT扫描被用来识别两枚银币和一个铃铛。
